description: Find verified independent vacation rentals. Filters are strict: every listed amenity must be present. With dates, results include a cached availability signal and an indicative all-in total (no guest service fee). Maps to GET /v1/search.

amenities.description: Amenity codes, e.g. hot_tub, wifi, ev_charger, dedicated_workspace, pool, fireplace_wood.

check_in.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD. With check_out, only places free for the whole stay are returned, with an indicative total.

check_out.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD (the morning the guests leave).

instant_only.description: True to return only places that confirm instantly, without waiting for the host.

limit.description: Most results to return, 1 to 50. Default 8.

max_total_usd.description: Maximum all-in total in dollars. Requires dates.

min_bedrooms.description: Fewest bedrooms the place must have.

min_wifi_mbps.description: Lowest Wi-Fi download speed needed, in megabits per second.

near_lat.description: Latitude to search around, with near_lng. Use instead of place when you have coordinates.

near_lng.description: Longitude to search around, with near_lat.

pets.description: Number of pets. Only places that allow that many are returned. Service animals don't count as pets.

place.description: Town and state/country, e.g. 'Asheville, NC'. Use near_lat/near_lng instead when you have coordinates.

radius_km.description: How far from near_lat/near_lng to search, in kilometres. Default 30.

step_free_entrance.description: True to return only places with a step-free way in.

name: search_stays

indicative_total.description: An amount in cents with its currency.

title: Search vacation rentals
